description: OpenBrowser - local desktop fingerprint browser: isolated Chromium profiles, proxy/fingerprint/extension control, batch management, window sync, local RPA, Local API + MCP (127.0.0.1:50325).
pre_install:
Get-Process OpenBrowser -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "$dir*" } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $sub = Get-ChildItem "$dir" -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^OpenBrowser-' }; foreach ($s in $sub) { Move-Item "$($s.FullName)/*" $dir -Force; Remove-Item $s.FullName -Force -Recurse };
# Self-heal patch for OpenBrowser main.js (runs from Scoop pre_install, $dir injected)
#
# Why: under Scoop the app dir "current" is a junction to the version dir
# (e.g. 1.0.23). Node resolves __dirname to the REAL target (1.0.23), but the
# renderer's loaded document URL keeps the junction NAME (current). OpenBrowser's
# trusted-IPC check compares these two file:// URLs and rejects the real UI as
# "untrusted IPC document", breaking every Local-Settings button (choose custom
# kernel, download kernel, storage dir, ...).
#
# Fix (v2, both-sides): add a normFileUrl() helper that resolves a file:// URL to
# its real (junction-resolved) form, and normalize BOTH the expected URL and the
# sender URL before comparing. Idempotent; re-applies after each scoop update.
#
# Encoding: main.js is UTF-8 (no BOM) and contains Chinese strings; read/write
# with explicit UTF-8 so PowerShell's default (ANSI/GBK) encoding can't corrupt them.

$mf = Join-Path $dir 'runtime\resources\app\main.js'
if (Test-Path $mf) {
  $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
  $c = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($mf, $utf8)

  # Idempotency guard: both-sides normalization already present -> skip
  if ($c.Contains('const expected = normFileUrl(trustedAppIndexUrl());')) {
    return
  }

  # Build JS string constants via [char]39 (single quote) to avoid nested-quote hell.
  $q = [string][char]39
  $i1    = "const { pathToFileURL } = require(" + $q + "url" + $q + ");"
  $i2    = "const { pathToFileURL, fileURLToPath } = require(" + $q + "url" + $q + ");"
  $idx   = "index.html"
  $plain = "return pathToFileURL(path.join(__dirname, " + $q + $idx + $q + ")).href;"
  # v1 single-side patch (realpath only on expected side) - revert it if present
  $v1    = "try { return pathToFileURL(fs.realpathSync(path.join(__dirname, " + $q + $idx + $q + ")).href; } catch (_) { return pathToFileURL(path.join(__dirname, " + $q + $idx + $q + ")).href; }"
  $anchor = "function trustedAppIndexUrl() {"
  $fn      = "function normFileUrl(url){try{return pathToFileURL(fs.realpathSync(fileURLToPath(String(url)))).href}catch(_){return String(url)}}"
  $e1     = "const expected = trustedAppIndexUrl();"
  $e2     = "const expected = normFileUrl(trustedAppIndexUrl());"
  $r1     = "const raw = String(senderUrl || " + $q + $q + ");"
  $r2     = "const raw = normFileUrl(senderUrl);"

  # (a) import line: add fileURLToPath (skip if already there)
  if ($c.Contains($i1) -and -not $c.Contains($i2)) { $c = $c.Replace($i1, $i2) }
  # (b) revert any v1 single-side patch to the plain form
  if ($c.Contains($v1)) { $c = $c.Replace($v1, $plain) }
  # (c) inject normFileUrl before trustedAppIndexUrl (idempotent guard)
  if ($c.Contains($anchor) -and -not $c.Contains($fn)) { $c = $c.Replace($anchor, $fn + "`n" + $anchor) }
  # (d) normalize both sides of the comparison
  if ($c.Contains($e1)) { $c = $c.Replace($e1, $e2) }
  if ($c.Contains($r1)) { $c = $c.Replace($r1, $r2) }

  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($mf, $c, $utf8)
}
post_uninstall: Get-Process OpenBrowser -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "*$dir*" } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
notes: Local API/MCP on 127.0.0.1:50325. Bundled Wayfern kernel works out of the box; to use the C++ fingerprint kernel, set OpenBrowser's kernel path to <scoop dir>\fingerprint-chromium\current\chrome.exe. Launch with 'OpenBrowser' from PATH.
